name: Tenstorrent Architecture — W&M CSCI654 Advanced Computer Architecture
description: Lecture 20 from William & Mary's graduate Computer Architecture course. Frames Tenstorrent in the landscape between GPUs and TPUs, draws comparisons to Cerebras and SambaNova, then dives deep into the Wormhole chip and Tensix core: the 5 RISC-V core design, SFPU, NoC, and dataflow execution model.
author: Yifan & GPU / William & Mary
